input.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'classic_bike' THEN MAX(0, duration_min - 45) * 0.10 ELSE CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN duration_min * 0.20 ELSE 0 END END) AS member_residual_charges FROM (SELECT duration_min, rideable_type FROM trips)

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'classic_bike' THEN unlock_fee ELSE 0 END + per_minute_rate * duration_min) AS pay_per_use_total FROM (SELECT duration_min, rideable_type, unlock_fee, per_minute_rate FROM (SELECT duration_min, rideable_type, CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'classic_bike' THEN 0.25 ELSE 0.50 END AS unlock_fee, CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'classic_bike' THEN 0.10 ELSE 0.20 END AS per_minute_rate FROM trips))
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', started_at)) AS months_spanned FROM trips
